invocation: interactive TUI driven through tmux, two sessions in empty scratch folders on gpt-6.1-sol, the second launched with -c disable_paste_burst=true so a long objective arrives as typed text; every objective was throwaway
note: field names, value types, counts, timings and the harness's own fixed wording only; no objective, model reply, path, thread id or typed word is recorded

turn_id_form: auto-compact-<n>, a counter, not the id of any turn

fixed_lines.set_or_edit: User set the goal: "<objective>" then User set goal status: "active".
fixed_lines.set_omitted: User set the goal: [objective omitted; exceeds the evidence limit]. then User set goal status: "active".

note: written by every user goal action, one message per action, before any event; the clear line is the only record of a clear

time_units: createdAt and updatedAt in seconds here, milliseconds in the sqlite row
carries_objective_whole: yes, up to the 4000 characters a set keeps inline, even when the user message omitted it

follows_user_message_by_ms.note: the 133 ms case wrote the over-4000 objective file first

written_for: an interrupt of a goal turn
never_written_for: a pause the model requested through update_goal

written_after: a set, or a resume on an idle thread

after_event_ms.note: the long case was a resume while the paused turn was still ending

opening_lines_seen.continuation: Continue working toward the active thread goal.
opening_lines_seen.after_edit: The active thread goal objective was edited by the user.

carries: the objective inside <objective> (continuation) or <untrusted_objective> (after an edit), plus token figures; model-facing, written at the start of each goal turn

rollout: a goal user message whose only line is User set goal status: "paused" (or "active"), then thread_goal_updated with that status a few milliseconds later
sqlite: the row's status flips in place; goal_id, created_at_ms and the token and time counters are kept
running_turn: pause did not stop the turn in progress; the model saw the status and stopped its own work. resume on an idle thread started a new turn with turn_trigger goal
model_side: after the user paused, the model also called update_goal with status paused inside a code-mode exec call, and no second event was written

trigger: Esc or Ctrl-C while a goal turn runs
rollout_order: goal user message: User set goal status: "paused".
meaning: an interrupt writes the same user line a typed /goal pause writes; only the turn_aborted beside it tells them apart

tui: an Edit goal field prefilled with the objective; enter submit, esc back
rollout: the same goal user message a set writes (User set the goal: ..., status active), then thread_goal_updated active with the new objective, then a goal.internal_context opening The active thread goal objective was edited by the user.
tells_edit_from_set: in the rollout only createdAt, which an edit keeps and a new goal resets; no clear line precedes an edit

tui_dialog.title: Replace goal?
options: Replace current goal: Set the new objective and start it now

rollout_order: goal user message: User cleared the goal.
goal user message: User set the goal: ...
sqlite: the row for the thread is replaced: new goal_id, new created_at_ms, tokens_used and time_used_seconds 0

rollout_order: goal user message: User cleared the goal.
goal user message: User set the goal: ...
meaning: a new goal over a completed one writes the clear line with no dialog, so a clear line does not mean the reader abandoned an open goal

rollout: one goal user message: User cleared the goal.; no thread_goal_updated

with_no_goal.tui_printed: No goal to clear This thread does not currently have a goal.
with_no_goal.rollout: the same User cleared the goal. line is written anyway

bare_goal_with_no_goal.tui_printed: Usage: /goal [<objective>|clear|edit|pause|resume] No goal is currently set.

sqlite: status complete, with tokens_used, time_used_seconds and updated_at_ms set
rollout_trace: only the model's own update_goal call inside a code-mode exec custom_tool_call, and its output text when the model's script printed the result; neither is a structured goal record
tui_only: the status line reads Goal achieved (<duration>)

objective_trimmed: a trailing space is trimmed before storing
omission_is_by_characters: the same 698 and 699 boundary held for two texts with very different token densities
over_4000: not refused: the objective is written to ~/.codex/attachments/<id>/goal-objective.md and the stored objective becomes the fixed sentence Read the Codex goal objective file at <path> before continuing.; the event and the sqlite row carry that sentence
pasted_over_threshold: a large paste becomes a pasted-text-1.txt attachment before /goal sees it, and the objective reads pasted text file: <path>. Read this file before continuing.

active_goal.how: the TUI was killed with SIGKILL while the goal turn ran, so the row stayed active
active_goal.what_happened: the turn kept running in the shared codex app-server daemon after the TUI died, and the resumed TUI attached to it

warm_only: both resumes found the thread still loaded in the app-server daemon; a cold resume after the daemon dropped the thread was not measured

runs: set, pause, resume, edit, replace, clear on an active goal, clear with no goal, bare /goal, a pasted 4001-character goal that completed
typed goals from 500 to 4001 characters, each left to complete
set, interrupt, resume into the session with the goal paused, /goal resume, SIGKILL, resume with the goal active, interrupt, clear
not_captured: a goal ending blocked, usage_limited or budget_limited
the goal objective must be at most refusal (no TUI path reached it)
a cold resume after the app-server daemon dropped the thread
codex exec beyond what was already known
